notes.title: WE WON BEST LATIN AMERICAN GAME AT GAMESCOM LATAM 2025 🎉
notes.notes:
This award means a lot to us. We’re two 41-year-old developers who have been working in the industry for 12–13 years, and this is the first time we’ve ever won something. So we’re really happy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118530/d9996b8ce8dabfc3f781f24d5a2c3c295854aa07.png[/img]

On a more personal note, just under two months ago, we suffered a huge loss. Pablo, a very important part of our studio and a dear friend, passed away after a long battle with cancer. We want to dedicate this award to him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118530/f4022dd841b6bb65f3bda81fc99cdd689d8f6252.jpg[/img]

To everyone who has supported us and helped us get to this point, we just want to say: we love you and we truly appreciate everything you’ve done for us.

Here’s to many more Pixel Pulps!

[i]LCB Game Studio[/i]

notes.title: Eye Witness Club is Here!
notes.notes:
Everyone, hi!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/edBpDBN.png[/img]

📢 We’re excited to announce [b]The Eye Witness Club (EWC)[/b]!

📝 [b]EWC [/b]is a fan art project open to everyone. The only requirement is to draw one of the featured creatures from our [b]Pixel Pulps[/b].

🐻🔪 We’re starting with the first one: [b]Grizzly Man[/b]!

Here's a character sheet Fer made for reference.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bS6wkw0.png[/img]

So, have you seen Grizzly Man? You can post your depictions here on [b]Steam [/b]or tag us on [url=https://x.com/lcbgamestudio][b]Twitter/X[/b][/url] or [url=https://www.instagram.com/lcbgamestudio/][b]Instagram[/b][/url]!

We have big plans for [b]EWC [/b]in the future!

Cheers and have a great one!

[i]- LCB Game Studio[/i]
